findings.title: rescheduleOccurrence reads the due date before taking the plan lock, so a waiting request uses a stale value
findings.evidence: const before = await tx.one<{ plan_id: string; due_on: string }>(
findings.why_it_matters: Under READ COMMITTED a second request blocked on FOR UPDATE still holds the due date it read before waiting. After a move from A to B, a request for B is not refused and logs a second due_reported; a request for A is refused although the date is now B.
findings.suggested_fix: Re-read the occurrence after the lock is held, as cancelOccurrence does, and use that value for the guard and the event.
